text:
maria: Quick sync — changelog cutoff for SDK v1.6 is EOD PDT today. I see a few sampleapp PRs and one docs PR still in review. Can owners call out final blockers?

alex: I'm on the sampleapp Node PR (#412). main blocker is the authAdapter tweak — tried to patch but need QA on staging. pinging @ryan for testing. :eyes:

ryan: I can run a quick smoke tomorrow morning (PDT). Is there a test checklist I should follow?

maria: Thanks @ryan — checklist: install from local tar, run quickstart flow, verify token refresh, check console logs for deprecation warnings. If you hit the authAdapter issue, note the stack trace.

jonathan: Docs PR (docs#88) has one unresolved wording nit and a missing code sample for the streaming response snippet. I can land once @sara confirms the sample is accurate.

sara: I'll validate the streaming example tonight. FYI the streaming API did change param name from `stream` -> `streaming` in runtime v2 — sample needs update.

maria: Good catch @sara. That means we should coordinate a tiny sampleapp bump too so quickstarts don't break. Alex, can you include the streaming param fix in the same PR or a follow-up with a clear migration note?

alex: I'll include it in #412 and add a migration note in the README. Patch diff: ```diff
- client.generate({ model: 'rwd-1', stream: true })
+ client.generate({ model: 'rwd-1', streaming: true })
```

pm-olivia: From PM side — to hit our marketing timeline we need the changelog published and the Quickstart blog queued. If anything blocks release, call it out now.

maria: Release blockers tally: (1) authAdapter QA (owner: alex/ryan), (2) streaming param docs + sampleapp bump (owner: jonathan/alex/sara), (3) changelog final review (owner: maria). Any other deps?

alex: There's also a small CORS tweak for the browser quickstart — I can push a one-line fix.

ryan: I tested Node install locally, authAdapter reproduces on my machine. I'll attach logs shortly.

release-bot: Deploy window reminder — staging smoke window 10:00 PDT tomorrow. Please have qa sign-off before then. :clock10:

maria: OK, plan: Alex/ryan pair on QA tonight, jonathan/sara finish docs + streaming sample, I will cut changelog draft and drop in #changelogs for review by 9am PDT. If we get green by 9:30am, release goes ahead during staging window.

jonathan: I'll add the streaming snippet and run a sampleapp build now.

alex: Starting QA run in ~20m, will post results here.

maria: Thanks team — drop quick notes here (or link PRs). I'll update the release checklist. :shipit:
